@@U00400@@
(Outside the door.)

@@U00401@@
Only me.

@@U00403@@
Come in!

@@U00405@@
You have to say it three times.

@@U00407@@
All right, come in, then!

@@U00409@@
(Entering.)

@@U00410@@
That's the way! I like you better already! I suspect we'll hit it off famously. Yes, I’m certain we will. Besides, to sweep away your melancholy moods, I’ve come this time as a noble cavalier, scarlet doublet trimmed in gold, a cloak of splendid rustling stiff silk, a fashionably long rapier at my side, and a cock’s feather stuck in my hat. Take my advice, friend, dress as I’m dressed, free yourself, let yourself go, throw off the yoke that holds you in check, and discover for the first time the adventure that life can be.

@@U00412@@
Whatever I wear, what is this earth but a prison, a narrow, confining cell that denies me liberty! Too old to do anything but play, too young not to burn with desire, what satisfaction can life offer?
translation:
@@U00400@@
（在门外。）

@@U00401@@
只有我。

@@U00403@@
进来吧！

@@U00405@@
你必须说三遍。

@@U00407@@
好吧，那就进来吧！

@@U00409@@
（进入。）

@@U00410@@
就是这样！我已经更喜欢你了！我想我们会一拍即合。是的，我确信我们会的。另外，为了一扫你们忧郁的心情，我这次以高贵的骑士身份而来，猩红色的金色镶边上衣，华丽的丝绸斗篷，沙沙作响，身旁有一把时尚的长剑，帽子上插着一根公鸡羽毛。朋友，听从我的建议，穿得像我穿的那样，释放你自己，放飞自我，摆脱束缚你的枷锁，第一次发现生活的冒险。

@@U00412@@
无论我穿什么，这个地球不过是一座监狱，一座狭窄的牢房，剥夺了我的自由！太老了除了玩耍什么也做不了，太年轻了不能被欲望所燃烧，生活还能提供什么满足呢？
